name: tourm
description: Travel website with tour packages, package variants covering hotels and flights, and a blog. TypeScript with a MySQL database.

paragraphs: CREATE TABLE blogs ( id INT AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, excerpt TEXT, description TEXT, thumbnailImage VARCHAR(255), bannerImage VARCHAR(255), author VARCHAR(100), category VARCHAR(100), date DATE, readTime VARCHAR(50), featured TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, status TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, metaTitle VARCHAR(255), metaDescription TEXT, metaKeywords VARCHAR(255) );

CREATE TABLE packages ( id INT AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, destinationtype VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, destination VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, duration VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description TEXT, packagecost DECIMAL(10,2), packageprofitpercentage DECIMAL(5,2), packageofferedprice DECIMAL(10,2), packagestrikethroughprice DECIMAL(10,2), packagevariants INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, priority DECIMAL(10,2), featured TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, status TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, createdat TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENTTIMESTAMP );

CREATE TABLE packagevariants ( id INT AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, packageid INT NOT NULL, variantname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, hotelname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, hotelcategory VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, flightsincluded TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, outboundflight JSON, returnflight JSON, FOREIGN KEY (packageid) REFERENCES packages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
